Use case: precise-object-edit. One full square transparent RGBA native >=1024 sprite. Precisely edit image1 E15 of the ice-sword girl, keeping the entire head, hair, torso, sleeves, hand positions, right ice sword held behind and left blue talisman in front, costume, camera, framing, scale and rear LEFT support leg locked. Image4 is approved art style, image5 only provides eastward gait rhythm; never copy its character, clothes, scenery or text.
Only improve the FRONT free anatomical RIGHT lower leg and boot: keep a natural soft knee bend, bring its ankle and boot a modest amount back closer under the raised knee, reducing the far forward split-kick distance by roughly one fifth. Lower the toe's excessive upward pitch so the boot presents a clean SIDE profile pointing SCREEN RIGHT with a nearly level sole, only slight natural toe lift. Do not rotate the shoe toward the viewer or display a large sole panel. The front right boot stays airborne, preparing to descend on E16 then land on E01. The rear LEFT foot keeps its current rear forefoot support spot, rear heel may stay raised. Preserve two independent poses across adjacent frames; do not copy an adjacent frame wholesale. Keep natural hip–knee–ankle–shoe linkage and original limb lengths. Do not move entire character, change support leg, add hands or weapons, crop extremities, or add shadow/background/grid/text.
